Home/Components/Dropdowns

Dropdowns

Toggleable content overlays

Basic Dropdown

A simple dropdown menu:

ActionAnother actionSomething else
Separated link
html
<div class="kb-dropdown">
  <button class="kb-btn kb-btn-primary">
    Dropdown
    <i class="fas fa-chevron-down"></i>
  </button>
  <div class="kb-dropdown-menu">
    <a href="#" class="kb-dropdown-item">Action</a>
    <a href="#" class="kb-dropdown-item">Another action</a>
    <div class="kb-dropdown-divider"></div>
    <a href="#" class="kb-dropdown-item">Separated link</a>
  </div>
</div>

Dropdown Variants

Dropdowns with different button styles:

ActionAnother action
ActionAnother action
html
<button class="kb-btn kb-btn-secondary">...</button>
<button class="kb-btn kb-btn-success">...</button>

Dropdown Directions

Dropdowns that open in different directions:

ActionAnother action
ActionAnother action
html
<div class="kb-dropdown-menu kb-dropdown-menu-up">...</div>
<div class="kb-dropdown-menu kb-dropdown-menu-right">...</div>

Dropdown with Icons

Dropdown items with icons:

ProfileSettingsNotifications
Logout
html
<a href="#" class="kb-dropdown-item">
  <i class="fas fa-user"></i>
  Profile
</a>

Split Button Dropdown

Dropdown with split button:

ActionAnother action
html
<div class="kb-dropdown kb-dropdown-split">
  <button class="kb-btn kb-btn-primary">Action</button>
  <button class="kb-btn kb-btn-primary kb-dropdown-toggle">
    <i class="fas fa-chevron-down"></i>
  </button>
  <div class="kb-dropdown-menu">...</div>
</div>
